function.name: lookup_control
function.description: Authoritative text for a control id (e.g. AC-2 in NIST 800-53, PR.AA-05 in CSF 2.0).

function.name: search_controls
function.description: Keyword search across control titles/statements; returns citable ids.

function.name: nerc_cip_requirement
function.description: AUTHORITATIVE, LOCAL lookup of exact verbatim NERC CIP requirement/Part text from the maintained bitemporal register (e.g. 'CIP-007-6 R2 Part 2.2', or 'CIP-007-6 R2' for every Part). Use this FIRST for ANY question asking what a specific CIP standard/requirement/Part currently, historically, or in the future requires — it resolves lifecycle/validity dates deterministically and returns the exact verbatim text with related 800-53 controls. Prefer this over web_search or browser tools for CIP standard text: an external fetch cannot verify effective-date selection or exact revision the way this can, and a generic search result is not a substitute for the maintained register.

function.name: nerc_cip_currency
function.description: Per-standard NERC CIP currency: held version, whether a newer version PDF is published on nerc.com, and an explicit 'verify the enforcement date'. Currency is never inferred; honest-BLOCKED when nerc.com is unreachable.

function.name: map_frameworks
function.description: Cross-framework mapping for a control id via the bundled OLIR-style crosswalk seed.

function.name: patch_evidence
function.description: CIP-007-6 R2 patch-evaluation record for a CVE (uses vulnintel triage).

function.name: refresh_catalogs
function.description: Re-pull the authoritative OSCAL catalogs (NIST 800-53 Rev5, CSF 2.0) into the local data dir.

function.name: compliance_ingest
function.description: Ingest a folder of the operator's policy AND procedure PDFs into the compliance corpus in one pass. Idempotent, re-runnable. Derives and queues layer (policy/procedure/evidence) and authority tier per document from its own title/filename/document-control block; reports a layer census (zero procedures means no coverage cell can reach FULL).

function.name: compliance_search
function.description: Free-form retrieval over the ingested compliance corpus (kb_id, query, top_k).

function.name: compliance_gaps
function.description: Coverage matrix: where the operator's ingested corpus does/doesn't cover each applicable NERC CIP Part, at the derived asset scope. FULL requires a located span from both a policy and a procedure. Filter by standard/requirement id prefix for pagination. Every row derived from an open review-queue item names it; COMPLIANCE_CONFLICT surfaces as its own field.

function.name: compliance_orphans
function.description: Ingested policy/procedure sections mapping to no requirement in the coverage matrix — dead weight, or evidence the requirement register is incomplete.

function.name: compliance_change_impact
function.description: Impact of a standard-version transition (e.g. old_standard='CIP-003-8', new_standard='CIP-003-9') on the operator's mapped sections — which prior coverage verdicts are now unverified, gated on applicability.

function.name: compliance_mappings
function.description: List/filter the mapping store (requirement -> internal document/section), and the SME override rate (the trust signal).

function.name: compliance_scope
function.description: The asset applicability scope derived from the operator's own ingested corpus, with citing evidence — queued rather than asked for.

function.name: compliance_route
function.description: Route a free-form compliance question to its intent (today / change / gaps / freeform) and the register node set that path operates on.

function.name: compliance_review_list
function.description: The review queue: open (default) or filtered judgements the system proceeded on without blocking — applicability scope, document tiers, mapping proposals, conflicts, low-confidence extractions.

function.name: compliance_review_decide
function.description: Confirm or reject one open review-queue item. Reversible: writes a new row superseding the prior one; nothing is overwritten. Confirming a mapping_proposal approves it in the mapping store directly. Requires an operator-issued reviewer_token; decided_by is caller-supplied context only and is NOT what gets recorded as the deciding principal.

reviewer_token.description: Operator-issued token identifying the authenticated reviewer. Without a valid token the decision is rejected (status: UNAUTHENTICATED) — this tool cannot record a review decision on the LLM's own authority.

function.name: compliance_sources
function.description: Exact permitted source context for an immutable document revision from the canonical compliance store — pass revision_id for an exact historical anchor, logical_id for the human-facing source-dir-relative name (e.g. 'CIP-007/Some Procedure.pdf'), or alias_path for the literal filesystem path. Verifies the source file's current bytes still match the recorded revision hash (drift detection).

function.name: compliance_trace
function.description: Bidirectional relationship traversal from a requirement/document/control reference in the canonical compliance store — forward, reverse, or both directions, cycle-safe and depth/work-budget bounded. Discloses depth-limited nodes and any truncated frontier explicitly rather than presenting a partial traversal as complete.

include_proposed.description: Widen beyond the governed approved-only edge surface to include proposed relationships — candidate-discovery use only.

function.name: compliance_prospective
function.description: What requires review when a new/revised NERC CIP standard takes effect — future-effective register content as of effective_on (default today), explicitly segregated from what is required today. Every row is marked prospective and must never be read as a current obligation.

function.name: compliance_scenario
function.description: An isolated before/after scenario for a proposed patch to one targeted requirement/Part, never written to any persisted document or the mapping store. Compares whether the candidate/qualification layer sees evidence for the obligation before vs. after the proposed text. Does not produce a compliance verdict or a full implementation plan.

function.name: compliance_draft_revisions
function.description: What revisions would improve alignment for a standard-version transition (e.g. old_standard='CIP-003-8', new_standard='CIP-003-9') — what must change and why, with both verbatim spans, for every mapped section affected by a substantive change. Specification only: does not draft replacement language itself.
